analyst.note: One configured frontier analyst for every synthesis edition. MARKET_BRIEF_MODEL overrides the OpenRouter model ID (and disables the fallback); fallback_model is attempted once, only when OpenRouter reports the primary has no available endpoint. The resolved identity, route, whether fallback occurred, and usage are recorded per run.

PREMARKET.guidance: The day's one rich read: prior close, overnight and premarket evidence, cross-asset context, today's events, and the open questions carried from the previous close.

OPEN_30M.guidance: The one interpretive update after the open, with the full evidence record. In order: what the open did to the premarket read; the strongest and weakest sectors and whether the move is broad or concentrated; the release or report that explains it by ID, or say plainly that none in these sources does; one supported read and its strongest rival; rates only with their date (the official curve is the previous business day's). Concise: about 60 words of summary. No later edition reinterprets the session.

WEEK_AHEAD.guidance: The Sunday week ahead, one read of the completed week and the week to come; the daily briefs do not carry it forward. Tell the story that survived the week, organized by hypothesis, not by day: what the week taught us (summary, take), which relationships strengthened, broke or stayed unresolved (relationships, each new here, citing the dated archived rows), and how participation, rates, real yields, volatility and cross-asset leadership behaved (equities and macro). Archived rows are dated session records with their original source; cite them with their dates, and use the -week rows for the week's settled returns. The week's earlier hypotheses are interpretation, not evidence. Name next week's scheduled releases, company events and market closures only from the supplied events and the next-week calendar (events section), and say plainly when a source was unavailable. Watches are observable conditions for next week (SESSION, NEXT_CLOSE, NEXT_BRIEF or EVENT horizons), never predictions or trade language.

cadence_note: Only synthesis checkpoints carry an edition profile: PREMARKET (NYSE open minus thirty minutes) and OPEN_30M (open plus thirty minutes) on each trading day, and WEEK_AHEAD (Sunday 16:00 ET), one weekly synthesis over the completed week's archived session records, isolated from session continuity. OPEN_1M (open plus one minute), the hourly refreshes (exchange-clock hours inside the session) and CLOSE_1M (close plus one minute) are deterministic: they refresh observed rows under the last accepted interpretation and never call the analyst (see schedule.CHECKPOINT_KINDS). Budget: two analyst calls per trading day plus one weekly.
